LESSON: STRUCTURE OF THE ATOM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements, and Compounds
Topic 1.1: Structure of the atom

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Structure of the atom. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How is the structure of the atom important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the structure of the atom
2. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
3. classify elements into metals and non- metals
4. show interest in classifying elements into metals and non- metals

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: STRUCTURE OF THE ATOM
This lesson teaches Structure of the atom for Grade 9 INTEGRATED SCIENCE.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the structure of the atom
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. classify elements into metals and non- metals
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. show interest in classifying elements into metals and non- metals
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Structure of the atom using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Structure of the atom above.
2. Explain Structure of the atom to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Structure of the atom.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Structure of the atom with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Structure of the atom important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the structure of the atom important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the structure of the atom
2. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
3. classify elements into metals and non- metals
4. show interest in classifying elements into metals and non- metals

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
